up: Retrieve up to 1000 IC50 activity rows for the human target CHEMBL1250411 (Short transient receptor potential channel 5). Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Filter for exact standard relation '=' (activities.standard_relation = '=') and non-null pChEMBL values (activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL). Ensure the target is human (target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606). Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1250411' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
